#### 1. alpha thalassemia-X-linked intellectual disability syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.778)

**How to falsify it:** Identification of distinct, non-overlapping sets of downstream molecular pathways affected by ATRX mutations in hematopoietic stem cells versus neuronal cells, or the absence of alpha-thalassemia phenotype in individuals with loss-of-function ATRX mutations affecting only myelodysplasia or intellectual disability. _(variant: The presence of common loss-of-function variants in ATRX in the general population (gnomAD) that do not segregate with either disease would falsify the claim that these specific variants are causal.)_
